# UI contract (generated by scripts/generate-ui-contract.py)

What each Winterchilla UI test needs from the site under test. Run them against another implementation with
`UI_BASE_URL=<origin> vendor/bin/pest tests/Browser/Admin tests/Browser/User tests/Browser/Guest --exclude-group=winterchilla-only`.
Selectors are CSS (`#id`, `[data-testid=...]`); `see` lists visible-text assertions; paths are what the test navigates to (`{...}` are seeded IDs).

## Guest/MiscRoutesTest.php

- **redirects /eqg/[id] to the movie page**
  - paths: `/eqg/{MOVIE_ID}`
  - see: “Equestria Girls”
- **redirects /eqg/[name] to the movie slug URL**
  - paths: `/eqg/2`, `/eqg/friendship-games`
- **redirects a post share link to the post on its show page**
  - paths: `/s/{base_convert((string)POST_ID, 10, 36}`
  - see: “Seeded Test Request”
- **404s on unknown or malformed share links**
  - paths: `/s/zzzzz`, `/s/req/999999`, `/s/bogus/1`
  - see: “404”
- **shows the browser recognition page**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - paths: `/about/browser`
  - see: “Browser recognition test page”
- **hides the browser recognition page of a session from non-developers**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - paths: `/about/browser/1`
  - see: “403”
- **shows the components page**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - paths: `/components`
  - see: “Components”
- **serves the API docs page**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - paths: `/docs`
  - see: “API”
- **serves the muffin rating image as an SVG**

## User/DeviantArtAuthTest.php  (winterchilla-only)

- **signs in a new DeviantArt user and creates their account**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - paths: `/users`
  - selectors: `[data-testid="oauth-da-username"]`, `[data-testid="oauth-approve"]`, `.logged-in .user-name`
  - see: “OAuthNewUser”
- **signs in an existing user by their DeviantArt ID**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - paths: `/users/{USER_ID}/account`
  - selectors: `[data-testid="oauth-da-userid"]`, `[data-testid="oauth-da-username"]`, `[data-testid="oauth-approve"]`, `.logged-in .user-name`
  - see: “TestUser”, “Account Settings”
- **returns to the page the sign-in started from**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - selectors: `[data-testid="oauth-approve"]`, `.logged-in .user-name`
  - see: “OAuthNewUser”
- **shows an error when the user denies access**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - selectors: `[data-testid="oauth-deny"]`
  - see: “DeviantArt authentication error”, “access_denied”, “You decided not to allow the site to verify your identity”, “Sign in”
- **rejects a callback whose state does not match the session**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - paths: `/da-auth/end?code=some-code&state=not-the-session-state`
  - see: “DeviantArt authentication error”, “unauthorized_client”
- **sends a callback without a code or state back home**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - paths: `/da-auth/end`
  - see: “DeviantArt authentication error”
- **shows an error when the code cannot be exchanged for a token**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - selectors: `[data-testid="oauth-approve-invalid-code"]`
  - see: “DeviantArt authentication error”, “invalid_grant”, “Invalid or expired authorization code.”
- **renames the local user when their DeviantArt username changed**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - selectors: `[data-testid="oauth-da-userid"]`, `[data-testid="oauth-da-username"]`, `[data-testid="oauth-approve"]`, `.logged-in .user-name`
  - see: “RenamedAdmin”
- **does not reuse the return URL of an abandoned sign-in**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - paths: `/da-auth/begin`
  - selectors: `[data-testid="oauth-approve"]`
  - see: “Fake deviantart”
- **locks sign-in out after repeated failed token exchanges**  _(winterchilla-only)_
  - selectors: `[data-testid="oauth-approve-invalid-code"]`, `[data-testid="oauth-approve"]`
  - see: “invalid_grant”, “DeviantArt authentication error”, “time_out”
